abstract: PRISM uses machine vision to track color changes in a 96-well plate and measure amide-coupling kinetics. The authors screened 1,085 reactant pairs and obtained 363 measurable rate constants. They used these measurements to evaluate machine-learning models of amide-coupling reactivity.
